neet_che_u05_t06_1.working: K3[Fe(CN)6] dissociates into 3K+ and [Fe(CN)6]3-. That gives 4 ions, so i = 4.

neet_che_u05_t06_3.working: For dimerisation, i = 1 − α/2 = 1 − 0.375 = 0.625. Apparent M = 122/0.625 = 195.2 g/mol.

neet_che_u05_t06_4.working: Dissociation increases the number of particles, so the observed molar mass is lower than the true value. A is false and R is true.

neet_che_u05_t06_5.working: I: CaCl2 gives i·m = 3×0.1 = 0.3 and NaCl gives 2×0.15 = 0.3, so the boiling points are equal. II: complete dimerisation gives i = 0.5, so M = 120 g/mol. Both statements are correct.
